paragraphs.text: Cayth , known as a Famed Mechanist , is a dwarf artificer from an unknown plane.

Cayth was introduced as a character in Modern Horizons 3 Commander as an alternate commander of the "Creative Energy" deck. She is a middle-aged woman with greying brown hair. Cayth can create and upgrade Servos . As other creatures enter the battlefield, she either strengthens them or creates more servos. Cayth also can populate or proliferate .
